title: DWD ICON Weather Model Archive
description: Archive of raw GRIB2-format numerical weather prediction output from the ICON-EU model run by Germany's national weather service (DWD), covering all vertical levels and variables for the four daily runs (00/06/12/18 UTC) over Europe. Files are copied unmodified from DWD's short-lived rolling archive and the collection is updated four times daily.
readme:
## README.md
## DWD ICON Weather Model Archive

Archives of NWP data from Germany's National Meteorological Service, the [Deutscher
Wetterdienst](https://www.dwd.de/EN) (DWD).

DWD maintains only a 24-hour rolling window of files [on their
servers](https://opendata.dwd.de/weather/nwp/), some of which we archive here.

The files are in GRIB (GRIdded Binary) Edition 2 (GRIB2) format, compressed with bzip2. We currently archive GRIB2 files from DWD's
[ICON-EU](https://www.dwd.de/EN/ourservices/nwp_forecast_data/nwp_forecast_data.html) model. For
ICON-EU, we archive all vertical model levels, and all NWP variables, for 4 NWP runs per day (the runs initialised at 00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC). Each file is copied without modification from DWD. Each model run consists of 77,805 files, totalling
about 59 GiB or 86 TiB per year. We do not archive the pressure
level files.

This archive on Source Cooperative is updated four times per day.

Individual files are added to the archive atomically (thanks to the atomicity guarantees of cloud
object storage). So you should never see an incomplete file. In contrast, directories are not
updated atomically. If you read the directory for the most recent NWP run then the directory may be
incomplete.

A subset of the variables in these files will be available in a cloud-optimized Icechunk Zarr
format, see [dynamical.org](https://dynamical.org) for availability.

To avoid having single directories with millions of files, we use a slightly different directory
structure to DWD's directory structure. Our directory structure is: 

- NWP model name
- Spatial grid
- UTC NWP initialization datetime in YYYY-MM-DDTHH format
- NWP variable name
- Filename `{prefix}_{init time}_{lead time hour}_{NWP variable name}.grib2.bz2`

For example: `https://data.source.coop/dynamical/dwd-icon-grib/icon-eu/regular-lat-lon/2026-02-11T00/t_2m/icon-eu_europe_regular-lat-lon_single-level_2026021100_001_T_2M.grib2.bz2`

The code that copies the files from DWD to this repository is [available on
GitHub](https://github.com/dynamical-org/reformatters/tree/main/src/reformatters/dwd). This code was
written with support from Open Climate Fix, funded by a grant from the [Patrick J McGovern
Foundation](https://www.mcgovern.org). The compute to transfer the files is provided by
[dynamical.org](https://dynamical.org/).

*Data license*: [Creative Commons BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). To quote
[DWD's legal
notice](https://www.dwd.de/DE/service/rechtliche_hinweise/rechtliche_hinweise_node.html):
